patchName: Patch 2.2.23 — Popol and Kupa Revamp (Original Server)
source: MLBB Plus local data, updated to Patch 2.2.23 (Nov 11, 2026 Original Server). Hero base stats, titles, roles, skills and lore cross-checked vs MLBB in-game patch notes (Kazuki Official / mlbb.tools / timesaver.gg mirror), MLBB Wiki (Fandom) hero stats tables, and MLBBGuides / MLBB Draft hero DB (Nov 2026). Win/Pick/Ban rates are Nov 2026 community tracker estimates (MLBBGuides Nov 1 2026 + MLBBDex 2.2.23 tier list) — they shift daily, treat as tier guidance not live ranked data. New heroes Obsidia (130), Sora (131), Marcel (132), Hirara (133) are 2025-2026 additions included in 133 roster. Dori (Advance Server 2.2.30) is NOT in Original Server 2.2.23, so not included.

patchChanges.detail: Full revamp: Popol can now ride Kupa. New Passive Biting Cold, S1 Icefield Sprint / Alpha Assault, S2 Kupa Help Me / Surprise Attack, S3 We Are Icefield Predators (mount form with CC immunity).
Passive: Orb consumption now heals 20 (+3*Level) (+20% PA). Ult CD 44-28s -> 60-44s, HP Regen on Basic during Ult removed, Enhanced Basic 30-60 (+100%) -> 100-200 (+70%), +30 MS while active.
S1 and S2 damage increased. S2 extra Basic Attack damage 30-45 (+30%) -> 60-90 (+40%).
S1 range increased, S2 minion/creep detection, Ult Light form debuff immunity -> CC immunity.
S1 slow -> removes boot MS effect, S2 minion/creep detection.
S1 PA Bonus 60% -> 75%, S2 PA Bonus 30% -> 50%.
S1 PA Bonus 90%->20% base, 20%->10% sustained (NERF), S2 detection improved, Ult Lightwheel 40->50, MS 20%->30% (BUFF).
S2 Growth 9->12, Total MP Bonus 45%->35%, Ult 400-650->350-500 base, 80%->70% Total MP.
Passive Basic Attack bonus 30%->15%, S2 HP Threshold no longer stacks.
Optimized indicator for max separation between Seimei Umbrella and Kagura. No damage change.

heroes.lore: Born at the end of the Era of Strife, Miya bore witness to the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss defiled the Shadow Swamp and corrupted many of her people into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis over Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to thrive again under its protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded by the fog of war. From the Moonlit Forest, a call to war that has not been heard in thousands of years sounded again. Miya took up her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people.
heroes.description: Miya counters targeted CC heroes with her invisibility and out-scales most marksmen late game. Weak to burst assassins who can catch her before she goes invisible.

heroes.lore: Born in a traditional Orc tribe in the Roaring Wilderness, Balmond learned combat from his father and tales of the Orcs' lost northern glory. After defeat and exile, the Orcs were scattered and oppressed by demons who plundered their tribes. Balmond slew a demon raiding leader and sparked a rebellion that united the scattered tribes. Surrounded and facing extinction, he tore a demon's throat with his teeth, drank its blood, and went berserk with power that broke the demon lines. Alice promised the return of the Roaring Wilderness for Orc loyalty, so Balmond swore to the Abyss while secretly planning to use that strength to revive the Orc kingdom.
heroes.description: Balmond bullies squishy laners early and secures objectives with True Damage execute. Falls off late vs kiting marksmen.

heroes.countersReason: Saber has a strong measured matchup into mobile or fragile targets that can be caught by his targeted ultimate. He struggles more into durable heroes and sustained damage. Marcel is his strongest measured ally in this sample.
heroes.lore: Once called Duan Meng, Saber grew up in a quiet village in the northern mountains of the Cadia Riverlands, home to the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect. Under Master Longma, he became the Sect's leading young swordsman, then travelled undefeated until the mysterious Zhixu defeated him twice, even shattering his sword. Desperate for invincible swordsmanship, he went to Laboratory 1718, where scientists transformed him into a mechanical human weapon and erased his memory. Reborn as Saber, he served as the laboratory's killing tool until buried memories stirred and he severed his neural control implant and destroyed the laboratory. Now he wanders the Land of Dawn searching for his lost past, certain that a destined opponent still awaits his next challenge.
heroes.description: Saber counters immobile mages and marksmen with guaranteed lockdown. Weak vs tanks and heroes who can break his combo with CC immunity.

heroes.lore: Alice was the illegitimate daughter of a nobleman and a lowly dancer in the Antalus family, born with a powerful affinity for dark magic. Believing love meant serving her family, she acted as its hidden knife on southern battlefields, even enduring capture and torture by the Monastery of Light without betraying its secrets. Imprisoned, she learned she had been a pawn: her capture was a calculated deal between her family and the Monastery, and her father met her return with only cold eyes. In despair, she unleashed a mysterious orb's Abyssal power, gained crimson wings, and destroyed her family. Reborn as Queen of Blood, she led the Blood Demons to the Abyss and now fights to be the player who moves the pieces, never a pawn again.
heroes.description: Alice counters low-mobility teams with sustain and AoE drain. Needs orbs to scale — weak early if denied farm.

heroes.lore: Nana was the naughtiest Leonin of the Moonlit Forest in Azrya, born on a moonlit night with great spiritual power she could not control. Her reckless magic ruined the Leonins' newly built Meow Playground, and guilt drove her to leave home in search of a way to control her power. The little tanuki Molina, whom Nana had once saved, secretly followed her to the Shadow Swamp near the Land of Despair, where a mystical fruit could tame unruly energy. As Nana reached for the fruit, an Abyss-corrupted monster attacked, and Molina used her faltering transformation power to take Nana's form and shield her friend. Molina died, but shared her transformation power with Nana, who now continues her journey carrying Molina's blessing and the strength to protect others.
heroes.description: Nana counters dive assassins with Molina transform and passive revive. Strong in lane poke, weak vs high-burst who can one-shot through her passive.

heroes.lore: Tigreal was born into the noble Wertz family of the Moniyan Empire, whose generations had guarded Moniyan's imperial power and security. Trained from childhood in Lumina City, he joined the Imperial Army at sixteen and became the youngest member ever of the Knights of Light, the Light's Order. As commander of the Second Regiment in the Barren Lands, his troops advanced alone through a command mistake, were besieged, and suffered heavy losses while his deputy Roland stayed behind to cover their retreat. The high command then blamed the regiment as disobedient, denied its honor, and tried to buy Tigreal's silence with medals and promotion. He left for the Northern Vale, learned that a companion's life matters more than victory, and returned to lead the Light's Order in guarding Moniyan against darkness.
heroes.description: Tigreal counters grouped enemies with Implosion. Needs Flicker to land the perfect engage. Weak if his ultimate is baited.

heroes.lore: Alucard's father, a comrade of Tigreal, disappeared with the Second Regiment in a battle against demons and was later declared dead and labelled disobedient. Determined to restore his father's honor and destroy all demons, Alucard joined the Monastery of Light, trained under Tigreal's visits, and became its Arbiter of Light. During a hunt in the Barren Lands, a magic blade wounded him, darkness entered his body, and his right arm began a strange transformation that he hid beneath a gauntlet. An old survivor then revealed the truth: glory-hungry high knights had trapped the regiment, and Alucard's father had covered Tigreal's retreat before vanishing. When the Empire refused to clear his father's name and the Monastery called him a heretic, Alucard left in anger and now hunts demons alone while searching for clues about his father.
heroes.description: Alucard counters squishy backlines with lifesteal sustain. Hard-countered by anti-heal (Sea Halberd, Dominance Ice, Glowing Wand) and CC chains.

heroes.lore: Karina was the finest killer among the Dark Elves of the Shadow Swamp, trained from childhood as a cold-hearted assassin who would use any means to complete a mission. Yet she shielded her younger sister Selena from that violent world, keeping Selena ignorant of her work and treasuring her as her only comfort and home. As Selena grew uneasy over Karina's long absences and wounds, she followed her sister, witnessed her in battle, and sought power for herself from their clan leader. That leader, already corrupted by the Abyss, led Selena to sacrifice herself, and the Lord of the Abyss warped her wish to protect Karina into a tool of destruction. Karina failed to defeat her transformed sister, so she left the Shadow Swamp to take vengeance on the Abyss and demons, still hoping one day to bring Selena home.
heroes.description: Karina counters low-HP squishies with True Damage execute. Weak vs tanks and CC that stops her reset chain.

heroes.lore: Akai was a chubby panda fish seller in Stream Valley who dreamed of becoming a hero but whose eager help usually caused more trouble than it solved. While fishing, he caught a frog who called himself the Frog Immortal, claimed to be a disciple of the Great Dragon, and became Akai's demanding martial-arts master. Akai learned his Panda Punches, then grew dazzled by the four Oriental Fighters - Zilong, Wanwan, Ling, and Baxia - and abandoned his master to seek true training at the Dragon Altar. Disaster struck when Yu Zhong marched on the Dragon Altar and the released Sun stormed Stream Valley to reclaim it from the pandas, forcing Akai to choose between glory and his people. Remembering that a true hero fights for the people, not glory, Akai returned and fought Sun beside the Frog Immortal, becoming Stream Valley's true panda hero.
heroes.description: Akai counters grouped enemies and can isolate carries. His ultimate is one of the best peel and engage tools in the game.

heroes.lore: Franco grew up on the Frozen Sea coast of the Northern Vale, where his people prized tall, rugged warriors descended from the Iceland Golem, while small Franco was mocked as fit only to be a merchant. Refusing that judgment, he left his tribe and trained alone for years in the mountains, enduring bitter cold, beasts, and danger until he gained strength far beyond an ordinary man. Meanwhile, the cruel pirate Captain Bane broke the pirates' old rules, built the Black Sharks fleet, and blockaded Franco's tribe, demanding submission or annihilation. Franco returned, crushed Bane's raiders, united the Northern Vale against him, and sank Bane's flagship Behemoth by infiltrating the pirate fleet after seeing through Bane's false peace offer. He restored the harbor and trade and was hailed as the Frozen Warrior, yet he fights on because Bane survived, gained new power, and is gathering his men to return.
heroes.description: Franco counters immobile carries with hook + suppress. High skill ceiling — a missed hook can lose a fight, a landed hook wins it.

heroes.lore: Born into a pirate family in the Northern Vale, Bane was raised and trained strictly until he became the most feared pirate of his time. His ambition was greater still, so he murdered his uncle, seized the fortress-ship Behemoth, and broke the pirates' ancient rule of non-interference by annexing other territories. She traveled south to a grim fortress, and over two lonely years grew from a princess into Ridgeburg's capable duchess, becoming her people's greatest hope after Atticus vanished. When Atticus finally returned, his wedding gift unleashed a wicked voice, and he and his men twisted into demons of the Abyss, ravaging the city they had sworn to protect. The forest was terrorized by wolves led by Whitefang, the Wolf King, whose ancient magic made the pack ferocious and drove them to attack travelers and villages. When Whitefang was about to devour an injured little girl, Ruby, Roger snatched her to safety and drove the pack back, but Whitefang's claws left him wounded and infected. Haunted by fear of revenge, he trained the villagers, then fled when the curse took hold, transforming under the full moon into a spitting image of Whitefang himself. Fearing he would harm those he swore to protect, he left home for a lone journey, vowing to eradicate the werewolf threat and avenge what the curse had stolen from him.

matchupData.coverage: 133 of 133 heroes have sourced entries in all three categories: 4-5 favorable matchups, 4-5 best measured allies, and 3-5 toughest matchups.
matchupData.method: Favorable matchups and best measured allies use the source CSV top-five counter and synergy lists. Toughest matchups are derived by reversing favorable-counter edges and ranking by weighted appearances (5 to 1). For the 43 heroes with fewer than three reverse edges, the top three direct ranked counter picks from MLBBHub are used instead. Placeholder IDs/names are excluded. These are statistical associations, not guarantees.
matchupData.sourceNotes: MLBB Meta Analyser is a third-party project that reports extracting ranked data from Moonton GMS and refreshing daily. MLBBHub per-hero pages publish ranked counter picks with win-rate advantage and were used for 43 low-coverage counter lists. MLCounters and MLBB.gg were consulted as secondary reference sites; no relationship was filled from generic role assumptions.
